title: Your biggest competitor already spent two years testing content with their own money
description:
Your biggest competitor already spent two years testing content with their own money, and Claude can pull every lesson out of their page in one sitting.

The loop has three steps. Step one, run their handle through Apify's Instagram Reel Scraper, which exports every reel they've posted with views, likes and comments. Step two, paste that export into Claude with one master prompt: it sorts by engagement, takes their top ten, and breaks down why each one won, hook type, topic, the pattern underneath. Step three, Claude writes three fresh scripts per winner in your voice, on your topics. That's thirty scripts, your content calendar for the month, built on testing they paid for.

The line that matters: you're cloning the strategy, never the content. No re-posting, no copying their words. You take the proven pattern and build your own on it. Honest part: the scripts come out 80 percent there, rewrite them in your own words or they'll sound like a robot wearing your face.

Comment CLONE and I'll send you the exact prompt.
